lines.text: Many learners say: Last week I am sick.
Better: Last week I was sick.
Last week is past. Say was.
Was! Last week I was at home.

data.why: Last week is past. Say was.

native.tip: Kita bilang “Minggu lalu saya sakit.” tanpa mengubah kata apa pun. Di bahasa Inggris, untuk minggu lalu pakai was, bukan am.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Last week I am sick.” 😅 Untuk minggu lalu, pakai was: “Last week I was sick.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “was”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Last week I was sick.” lalu tulis satu kalimat tentang minggu lalu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Minggu lalu saya sakit.” and change nothing. In English, for last week use was, not am.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Last week I am sick.” 😅 For last week, use was: “Last week I was sick.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
